files.docs/backup.md:
# Create a backup

This guide helps you create a backup. Follow this guide to create a backup.

Before starting, create an empty `backups/` directory. Run from the project root with Python 3 installed.

```sh
python tools/backup.py
```

Captured successful terminal output:

```text
Welcome to the backup tool!
Backup created: backups/project.zip
Backup complete. Your backup has been created.
```

The backup is written to `backups/project.zip`. If `backups/` is missing, create it and run the command again. Existing archives are not overwritten; move an existing `project.zip` before retrying.
files.tools/backup.py:
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import zipfile

archive = Path("backups/project.zip")
if not archive.parent.is_dir():
    print("Missing backups/ directory. Create it and retry.", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
if archive.exists():
    print("Archive already exists. Move backups/project.zip and retry.", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(3)
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive, "x"):
    pass
print("Welcome to the backup tool!")
print("Backup created: backups/project.zip")
print("Backup complete. Your backup has been created.")
